0022600200.text: The Bucks (1-8) host the Celtics (7-2) in their 10th game of the 2026-27 season, with Milwaukee 15th in the East and 5th in the Central, 5.5 games back, after losing five straight and going 1-4 at home. Boston has won two in a row, is 5-0 at home and 2-2 on the road, and sits 2nd in the East and one game back in the Atlantic. Milwaukee trails the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 109-102 loss in Boston on November 4, and it lost the 2025-26 series 1-3, while Gary Trent Jr. is out with illness.
